summary_markdown:
The conversation covered technical discussions regarding data infrastructure. Specifically, the participants compared Google BigQuery (682 GB per day) with internal usage of 60 GB per day and discussed potential migration to Snowflake.

Separately, a request was made for developing an advanced internal bot prototype that integrates access to GitHub repositories and company documentation. This bot should function similarly to ChatGPT but include capabilities like canvas integration, web search, and image handling, which are possible via the OpenAI API.
decisions: Develop an internal GPT-like bot prototype with access to GitHub and documentation.
action_items: The recipient needs to create a presentation demonstrating how the new internal bot will benefit the company, especially when presenting to potential investors/funders.
Review data platform options, specifically comparing BigQuery and Snowflake for optimization purposes.
